criteria.requirement: Repair toxml built-in tag/name/attribute styles to escape text versus attribute quotes exactly once; independent ElementTree parsing must recover original &, angle brackets, both quotes and Unicode. Escape displayed header text while retain original format field lookup; validate XML names for built-in structural paths/name-keys/attribute-keys and reject prohibited control characters. Keep custom raw format templates/prologue/epilogue explicitly raw and existing valid layout/None string behavior. Validation during streaming may leave partial target on bad later data; no atomic-write promise. Do not alter original tests.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
